name: Germany
visaRequirements: Schengen Visa required for most non-EU citizens
bestExperience: Best experience: Garmisch-Partenkirchen — the Partnachklamm gorge and the hike around it.

about.description: Germany rewards short trips more than long itineraries. The Bavarian Alps in the south, the sandstone towers of Saxon Switzerland in the east, and the Black Forest in the west are three completely different landscapes, and each is a comfortable long weekend rather than a two-week route. Everything below came from exactly that — single hikes and two-day road trips rather than one grand tour.
highlights: The hike behind Neuschwanstein — better than the castle itself
The Bastei Bridge in Saxon Switzerland

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: June to September for hiking; late November and December for the Christmas markets
transportation: Excellent long-distance and regional rail network
A car is worth it for the Alps, the Black Forest and Saxon Switzerland
Flixbus is the cheapest way between cities and into neighbouring countries
culturalNotes: Sunday closing is real — most shops shut all day
Cash is still expected in smaller places; don't assume card
Tap water is safe, but restaurants will default to selling you bottled
Trails are well signed and colour-coded, and signage is trusted
